# 楞伽經集註

**ID:** X0324
**Volume:** X17
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 宋 正受集記
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 4

## Contributors
- 正受 (A000264)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X324 in four fascicles is [正受](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A3%E5%8F%97)'s Southern-Sòng *jízhù* 集註 ("collected annotations") on *[Léngqiéābáduōluó bǎo jīng 楞伽阿跋多羅寶經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327)* (T670). The genre is anthological: rather than offering original commentary, the work assembles glosses from earlier *Laṅkāvatāra* commentators — [寶臣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E8%87%A3)'s [T1791](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0334) is heavily drawn upon — into a single working text, with [正受](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A3%E5%8F%97)'s own editorial frame supplying continuity and a Chán reading-lens.

**Abstract**

[正受](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A3%E5%8F%97) (sobriquet *Léiān* 雷庵), Línjì-school dharma-heir of Zhuóān Déguāng 拙庵德光 (1121–1203), is best known as the compiler of the *[Jiātài pǔdēng lù 嘉泰普燈錄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0010)* (the fifth of the great Sòng Chán lamp histories, completed 1204). The *Léngqié jízhù* is his single major scholastic-commentarial production. As a Chán-school *jízhù* on a sūtra that the Chán tradition claims for itself (since Bodhidharma's transmission of T670 to Huìkě), the work represents the Sòng Chán reading of T670 *qua* sūtra rather than *qua* lineage-credential. Date bracket follows [正受](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A3%E5%8F%97)'s mature productive period (post-1180, pre-*Pǔdēnglù* compilation 1204).

X324 was an influential late-Sòng / early-Yuán reference work and was the principal Chán-side complement to [寶臣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E8%87%A3)'s [T1791](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0334) in the medieval Chinese commentarial transmission of the *Laṅkāvatāra*.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (楞伽阿跋多羅寶經 / T670); doctrinal predecessor [KR6i0334](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0334) (注大乘入楞伽經 / T1791); [正受](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A3%E5%8F%97)'s lamp-record [KR6q0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0010) (嘉泰普燈錄).
